sources.name: HaGeZi Allowlist Referral
sources.description: Unblocks affiliate and tracking referral links that show up in mail and search results. HaGeZi's stricter blocklists remove some of those links; this native Adblock allowlist puts the referral exceptions back.

sources.name: GoodnessJSON Pi-hole Whitelist
sources.description: Domains that are safe to allow and that restore features large blocklists break, such as YouTube watch history and embedded video. The list leaves out advertising and tracking domains.
